system.description:
Secret (five tomes). Study: a caster with 5th-level spells for Flesh or Stone, 6th for Clay or Bone, 7th for Iron; 4 weeks, DC 15 (Iron 8 weeks, DC 20).

Teaches: building one golem of that kind (its block).

The work: the golem's Level × 1,000 sp and its Level in weeks, DC 15 (Iron 20), plus a Special Material: parts of six fresh corpses (Flesh), one block of quarried granite (Stone), riverbed clay that has never seen sunlight (Clay), the bones of a creature of Level 10+ (Bone), a ton of cold iron (Iron).

  • The manual burns when its golem wakes.
  • Written by the giant-smiths of the Never-ending War, who bound elemental spirits into stone and clay to fight the dragons.
  • Every manual left is a copy of a copy.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Studied in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
